career_ladder.note: Police Constables in Andhra Pradesh serve as frontline law enforcement personnel under the Andhra Pradesh Police (Stipendiary Cadet Trainee) Rules (G.O.Ms.No.315 Home Dept dated 13.10.1999) and the Andhra Pradesh Police Subordinate Service Rules (G.O.Ms.No.126 Home Dept). Personnel are deployed across Civil Police stations, Special Branch, Armed Reserve (AR), and Andhra Pradesh Special Police (APSP) battalions. Promotion through the subordinate non-gazetted ranks to Head Constable, ASI, and Sub-Inspector is governed by departmental qualifying tests, service seniority, and unblemished record (Annual Confidential Reports).

exam_scheme.note: The selection scheme conducted by the State Level Police Recruitment Board Andhra Pradesh (SLPRB AP) comprises three successive stages: (1) Preliminary Written Test (PWT) of 200 objective questions for screening, (2) Physical Measurements Test (PMT) and Physical Efficiency Test (PET), and (3) Final Written Examination (FWE). For Post Code 21 (Civil PC), final selection is based solely on 200 marks in FWE with PET being qualifying. For Post Code 23 (APSP PC), final selection combines 100 marks from FWE and 100 marks from PET (total 200 marks).

stages.source_label: SLPRB AP Notification Rc.No.161/SLPRB/Rect.2/2022, Para 20(A) & Annexure II

papers.paper_name: Preliminary Written Examination (Intermediate Standard: English, Arithmetic, Reasoning, General Science, History, Geography/Polity/Economy, Current Events)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% for OC/EWS (80/200), 35% for BC (70/200), 30% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen (60/200)

stages.stage_name: Stage 2: Physical Measurements Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
stages.source_label: SLPRB AP Notification Rc.No.161/SLPRB/Rect.2/2022, Para 20(B), 20(C) & Annexure I

papers.paper_name: Physical Measurements Test (PMT: Men Height min 167.6 cm, Chest 86.3 cm with 5 cm expansion; Women Height min 152.5 cm, Weight min 40 kg)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying standard prescribed in notification (relaxed for Agency Scheduled Tribes: Men 160 cm, Women 150 cm)

papers.paper_name: Physical Efficiency Test (PET: 1600m Run + 100m Run / Long Jump for Civil PC [Qualifying]; All 3 events graded for APSP PC [Max 100 Marks: 1600m 40 marks, 100m 30 marks, Long Jump 30 marks])
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying for Civil PC (Post Code 21); Scored out of 100 marks for APSP PC (Post Code 23) and counted towards final merit

stages.source_label: SLPRB AP Notification Rc.No.161/SLPRB/Rect.2/2022, Para 20(D), 20(E) & Annexure II

papers.paper_name: Final Written Examination (200 Objective Questions: English, Arithmetic, Reasoning, General Science, History of India, Geography/Polity/Economy, Current Events)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Minimum qualifying: 40% for OC/EWS, 35% for BC, 30% for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen. Graded out of 200 marks for Civil PC; Graded out of 100 marks for APSP PC

financial_package.note: Constables recruited by SLPRB AP are state-jurisdiction personnel remunerated under the Andhra Pradesh Revised Pay Scales 2022 (AP RPS 2022 / 11th PRC), notified vide G.O.Ms.No.1, Finance (PC-TA) Department, dated 17.01.2022. Direct recruit cadets undergo institutional training during which they receive a monthly stipend as fixed by the State Government. Upon successful completion of training, recruits are appointed into the regular time scale of pay ₹25,220 – ₹80,910 with an entry basic pay of ₹25,220.
financial_package.pay_source_label: SLPRB AP Notification Rc.No.161/SLPRB/Rect.2/2022, Para 30 read with AP RPS 2022 G.O.Ms.No.1 Finance Dept
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on AP RPS 2022 entry basic pay of ₹25,220 with standardized project benchmark 58% Dearness Allowance (₹14,628) and HRA ranging from 8% in rural mandal/town stations (₹2,018) to 16% in major urban centers such as Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam (₹4,035), plus monthly police uniform maintenance/washing allowance and special duty/risk allowance. In-hand estimate deducts 10% Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS/APGPS: ₹3,985), APGLI life insurance (~₹500), GIS (~₹60), and Professional Tax (₹200). Initial institutional training receives monthly stipend as determined by Government.
official_perks: Government police residential quarters or House Rent Allowance (HRA: 8% to 16% as per AP PRC 2022 classification)
Andhra Pradesh Employees Health Scheme (EHS) cashless medical coverage for police personnel and eligible dependents
Police uniform grant, kit maintenance allowance, and monthly washing allowance
Special Duty Allowance / Risk Allowance for APSP battalion personnel and high-risk security deployments
Contributory Pension Scheme (CPS) / Andhra Pradesh Guaranteed Pension Scheme (APGPS)
Annual surrender leave / extra month's basic pay compensation in lieu of working on public holidays and weekly offs
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) within Andhra Pradesh as per state government rules
